title: Cordelia. Cordoglio. Lir’s loneliest daughter
html_source:
Cordelia – King Lear’s estranged daughter in King Lear.

Lir derives from the sea god – mananaan mac lir and lonely from the ‘song of fionnuala'by Thomas Moore,

Off message – a work song – Fionnuala’s Bothy – 40 seconds in.
